summary: Gyrobot Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd manufactures intelligent mobile robots and automation systems tailored for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include autonomous mobile robots, intelligent storage systems, and comprehensive fleet management solutions aimed at enhancing efficiency in material handling within smart factories.
